title: Rust: Rule 2 compression
description: Implement Rule 2 compression in Rust. Acceptance: compresses IPv6/UDP, passes same vectors as Python.
close_reason: Spec Rule 2 is ICMPv6 Echo (spec/03-adaptation.md 5.5), not a second IPv6/UDP CoAP rule. rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs compress_icmpv6_echo + RULE_ICMPV6_ECHO=2. Vectors icmpv6_echo/icmpv6_echo_reply in test/vectors/schc_compression.json. cargo test -p lichen-schc --test shared_vectors passed.
